name: Arodi
overview: Arodi was a male member of the tribe of Gad, identified specifically as a son of Gad. He is mentioned among the descendants of Israel who journeyed to Egypt, marking his place within the early history of the Israelite people. His lineage is part of the broader narrative of the tribes of Israel during the patriarchal period.
namesAndTitles: The name Arodi means 'hunchbacked' in Hebrew. It is a proper name recorded in Genesis 46:16, but there is no indication that this name was given by God or carries a divine title.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Arodi as a son of Gad, establishing his direct paternal relationship. No other familial relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Arodi's significance lies in his inclusion among the sons of Israel who went to Egypt, a pivotal event that set the stage for the later deliverance of Israel. His descendants, known as the Arodites, are mentioned in the census of the tribe of Gad, indicating his role in the formation and identity of this tribe within the nation of Israel.
